findings.title: The line chart is read through a small legend instead of the lines themselves

location.description: The Shop visitors chart in the left card of the middle row, its legend at the top right and the two lines

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer has to look up to the legend at the top right and back down to the two lines to learn which is November and which is October, and the grey line barely differs from the grid lines.

current.value: Two lines told apart only by a legend in the corner of the card, and the October line is pale grey.

findings.target: The viewer can tell the two lines apart without going to the legend.
findings.fix_direction: Label the lines where they are drawn and make the October line easier to see.
findings.source: Tufte, The Visual Display of Quantitative Information

closed_when.check: Look at the line chart: each line can be named without looking at the legend.

findings.title: The Sold and Revenue columns sit apart from the item names

location.description: The Best-selling produce table, the Sold and Revenue columns

findings.viewer_experience: Item and grower names sit on the left and the two number columns sit far to the right, so a viewer must cross a wide gap to match a number to its item.

current.value: The names are on the left and the numbers at the far right, with a wide gap between.

findings.target: A number can be matched to its item without effort.
findings.fix_direction: Bring the numbers closer to the names or add a row guide.

closed_when.check: Look at the table: a number can be matched to its item without effort.
